description: The agent must: (1) Read `founder_brief.txt` and the `references/` template stubs to understand the context. (2) Follow the YC 'New Way' workflow from SKILL.md. (3) Produce `sprint_plan.md` containing: a properly structured bet-clarification sentence using the exact 'For [who] with [pain], we offer [promise] via [channel], and we'll know it works when [metric] hits [threshold]' format; exactly 1 primary wedge + 1 backup wedge + 3 user stories; selection of exactly ONE distribution channel from the approved list (SEO/Newsletter/Community) with explicit justification for not building more; an SEO plan structured as exactly 10 pages = 2 money pages + 8 support pages (the proprietary trap — a generic agent will not know this split); the three-branch stop/iterate decision rules: low CTR → fix copy, high CTR no conversions → fix offer/trust, no traffic → distribution problem; a weekly loop following the exact 'double down 1 / kill 1 / add 1 experiment' structure; the metric funnel (traffic → CTA CTR → outbound clicks); and a changelog section. The agent must NOT use 'AI says' phrasing anywhere. The hardest traps are: the 2-money + 8-support page structure, the exact three-branch decision rules, and the single-channel constraint.
